Keep CPU-written memory in system RAM: On by default for stability; off places it in video memory (faster in some games, unsafe for the desktop).
Built-in per-application profiles: On by default; off turns every shipped per-application profile off.
Card for an application: With more than one card: 0 is the primary, 1 the second and so on (up to 7), for every application (1) or per application (Game=1,*=0).

Low-latency mode (GPU work queued ahead): How many parts of GPU work may be queued ahead, 1 to 32 (default 16). A low number cuts input lag and can cost frame rate.
